title: Proscenium from the stalls
what: A front view from the audience: a carved proscenium, a truss with the followspot and four fixed lamps, a lectern, a mic stand, monitors and a stool on the boards, then a stage lip, a pit rail and rows of seats with people's backs and heads in front.
why: It is the view a contributor will have on 4 November: you are in the room, the sponsor's truss and lamp above you, the stage in front. The heads in the foreground make the 500-600 marketers physical, and the one blue pool of light sits on the mic stand: your place.
how: One 612 by 720 SVG of 1px lines, drawn back to front; floor boards, drapes, fluting, lattice and seat backs carry the detail. The pointer moves the pool with a spring, the lamp turns to it, the beam is redrawn from the lens, and the floor lines turn blue only inside the pool. On entry the lines draw in (about 1.2s) and the spot sweeps in from the side; reduced motion shows the final pose, mobile scales the same drawing and drops the finest lines.
